faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Vince Coglianese analyzes election battles, interviews Byron Donalds, and discusses…
kurzfassung: The host examines legal battles over redistricting in Missouri and Maryland alongside urgent appeals concerning mail-in ballot regulations. Congressman Byron Donalds joins the program to discuss his gubernatorial campaign in Florida, property taxes, and election integrity. Additionally, the episode highlights recent administration updates on deportations, fraudulent CDL mills, and significant reductions in prescription drug costs.
stichpunkte: Missouri Supreme Court invalidates congressional maps used in the primary election.
Maryland Supreme Court rules on ballot language regarding state redistricting measures.
The Trump administration files an urgent appeal with the Supreme Court over USPS mail-in ballot rules.
Congressman Byron Donalds discusses his campaign for Florida governor and state policy priorities.
Florida's potential property tax relief and Amendment 3 are analyzed.
Vice President J.D. Vance highlights a major crackdown on fraudulent CDL mills and illegal alien truck drivers.
DHS directs immigration attorneys to seek early dismissal of legally deficient asylum claims.
The administration reports historic drops in prescription drug costs under Trump Rx.

clips.text: The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously decided that the congressional district map utilized in the recent primary election was invalid.
The sponsor has successfully distributed more than 14 million bottles, gaining widespread trust among consumers and the production team.
Postal service regulations now mandate specific voter information and unique barcodes to be attached to every distributed mail ballot.
State leadership demonstrates high competence and speed when responding to seasonal hurricanes and rebuilding critical infrastructure.
Federal authorities shut down over 2,000 fraudulent commercial driver license operations to improve roadway safety and protect domestic workers.

beschreibung:
The Trump admin takes its election fight to the Supreme Court to protect new mail-in ballot rules; VP JD Vance takes the podium in the White House briefing room, delivering a victory lap on the crackdown on fraudulent CDL mills and illegal alien truckers; and Republican Florida gubernatorial nominee Byron Donalds joins the show to discuss his campaign, flock cameras, eliminating property taxes, and more!
